round_selection: Prefix rounds 0 through 4, inclusive, in every sponge permutation; not Keccak-p last rounds.
message_domain: Finite byte strings of bit length below 2^64.

relation.postcondition: The two complete keccak800-r5 hashes agree on all 256 output bits.

out_of_scope: Changing rounds, IV, padding, mode or output length
selection_note: Organizer-selected exploration target; no first-unbroken boundary is asserted.
padding: Legacy Keccak pad10*1 with no extra domain suffix; delimited suffix byte 0x01. Standard little-endian lane/bit encoding.
schedule: Theta, rho, pi, chi, iota using first-round constants truncated to 32 bits and rho offsets modulo32.
feed_forward: XOR message blocks into the rate; no Davies-Meyer feed-forward.
digest_encoding: First 32 squeeze bytes, little-endian Keccak lanes.
